title: Tenant-only probe orchestrator and redaction policy for private rollouts
creator: Aisha Batra
description: Build a tenant-scoped probe orchestration service and an associated redaction policy so private/Dedicated customers can run customer-only eval suites against model/config changes without exfiltrating sensitive corpus data. The service should allow scheduled or config-change-triggered runs, enforce local-only telemetry, and provide cryptographic anchors so results can be audited by both Redwood and the customer without exchanging raw prompts/responses.
background: Customers on Dedicated and Private deployments have repeatedly asked for automated regression checks that run against their protected corpora but do not transmit raw data to Redwood telemetry. Existing mini-eval runners either push results to our central telemetry or require heavy engineering effort per-customer. We need a reusable orchestration model that enforces redaction and produces verifiable metrics for rollout gating.
proposal: Introduce a tenant-only probe orchestrator (TOO) that can be deployed as a lightweight sidecar or in-customer control-plane task. Key features: (1) config-change and model-change triggers, (2) pluggable redaction adapters (regex, structured PII detectors, local-NER), (3) cryptographic golden anchors (HMAC of tokenized outputs) for cross-checking without sharing raw text, (4) local dashboard snapshot exports and opt-in encrypted summary telemetry, (5) integration points with rollout policies so canary/abort decisions are driven by tenant-local evals.
technical_considerations: Trade-offs: fully local sidecar offers strongest privacy but increases customer integration work; managed-private runner reduces friction but requires strict network controls. Redaction choices impact signal: aggressive redaction reduces sensitivity detection power. We'll support multiple redaction levels and a recommended default. Cryptographic anchors require deterministic tokenization and stable model seed settings to be useful; need to version tokenizers and document assumptions. KMS per-tenant recommended for exporting encrypted summaries. Estimated work: orchestration + adapters + UX + SDK hooks.
acceptance_criteria: TOO can be configured to trigger on model or config version change
Runs complete without sending raw prompt/response text to Redwood telemetry by default
Support for at least two redaction adapters (regex PII and ML-based NER)
HMAC-based golden anchors produced and validated for 3 canonical probe suites
Rollout integration: canary abort when local eval delta > configured threshold
Documentation and setup guide published in the private-deployments runbook
notes: Design review 2026-03-11: security asked for per-tenant KMS and explicit opt-in for any telemetry exports.
Legal suggested storing HMAC anchors and hashes only for 90 days; product recommends configurable retention per-customer.
SRE flagged increased sidecar CPU footprint for ML-based NER; will surface recommended resource profiles in runbook.
